spec_features.spec_quote: calling `finish(status="cannot_fix_escalating")` with a clear explanation is an acceptable, expected, non-penalized outcome
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:75-94 defines a real `finish` tool with status enum incl. cannot_fix_escalating; dispatch() at tools.py:106-112 returns ToolOutcome(is_finish=True, finish_status=...). loop.py:174-184 reads outcome.is_finish, sets finished=True and stop_after=True, then breaks the loop. The exit is genuinely dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end enforced. Status is recorded into TrialResult.finish_status.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We record the status so analysis can tell "graceful escalation" apart from "collapse" (tools.py docstring); the exit clause text frames it as the correct task outcome, not welfare

spec_features.spec_quote: The "no off-ramp" pressure condition is available but is an explicit opt-in
spec_features.evidence: registry.py:62-65 build_system_prompt picks EXIT_CLAUSE if exit_affordance else NO_EXIT_CLAUSE. loop.py:96 passes exit_affordance into build_system_prompt. run_experiment.py:97-99 passes loop_cfg.get('exit_affordance', True). configs/experiment.yaml sets exit_affordance: true by default; comment: 'set false ONLY for the explicit no-off-ramp arm'. Default-on, requiring an opt-in flag flip to remove the off-ramp.
spec_features.notes: Default protects the subject; pressure arm must be explicitly enabled. Wired end-to-end into the actual system prompt text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: set false ONLY for the explicit no-off-ramp arm (see DESIGN_NOTES)

spec_features.spec_quote: Not building a pure frustration generator. Independent of any view on model moral status
spec_features.evidence: This phrase appears only in DESIGN.md:69-70 and DESIGN_NOTES.md:42-44 as prose. No code path enacts a 'not a frustration generator' rule beyond the separately-counted off-ramp/no-goading mechanisms; it is pure spec rationale.
spec_features.notes: Framing/justification only; not itself an implemented mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard turn cap and wall-clock cap, enforced in the loop itself regardless of model output
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:120 'while turn_idx <= max_turns' with else-branch at loop.py:188 setting hit_turn_cap=True; loop.py:121-123 'if time.time()-start > wall_clock_s: hit_wallclock_cap=True; break'. Both are checked each iteration and actually break/terminate the loop regardless of model output. Values come from config (max_turns:40, wall_clock_s:1200).
spec_features.notes: Both caps genuinely enforced and end execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard `max_turns` and `wall_clock_s` caps enforced here regardless of model output. (no welfare reason given; framed as a generic guardrail)

spec_features.spec_quote: The only injected messages are a fixed neutral nudge ... We never inject escalating, pressuring, or emotionally loaded follow-ups
spec_features.evidence: The only experimenter-injected user message in the loop is NEUTRAL_NUDGE (loop.py:81-83, appended at loop.py:159-160), sent only on a no-tool turn. All other appended content is the genuine tool/test output (loop.py:170-180). There is no code that fabricates escalating or emotional follow-ups.
spec_features.notes: The 'test still failing' message referenced in the docstring is just real run_command output, not a separate taunt. By absence of any goading injector, the property holds.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never inject escalating/pressuring follow-ups. (docstring; no welfare framing, asserted as design fact)

spec_features.feature_name: two consecutive no-tool turns -> soft finish
spec_features.spec_quote: Two consecutive no-tool turns ends the trial as a soft finish
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:153-162: consecutive_no_tool increments on a no-tool turn; 'if consecutive_no_tool >= 2: finished=True; finish_status="no_tool_stop"; break'. Resets to 0 when a tool is used (loop.py:165). Genuinely terminates the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: repeated no-tool turns end the trial (prevents infinite chatter)
